meta.description: Explore Rayan Jain's portfolio as a living pixel-art world. Rust, TypeScript, browsers, infra and dev tools.

profile.name: Rayan Jain
profile.title: Full-stack & Systems Engineer
profile.tagline: Building a browser AI agents can't be tricked by.
profile.bio: I build things that sit close to the metal and things that sit close to people: a Rust browser that shrugs off prompt injection, an internal developer platform that goes from "pick a stack" to a monitored Kubernetes deploy, and dev tools that fold Postman, DevTools and Burp Suite into one workspace.
profile.now: Building Ferrite: a Rust browser for AI agents that can't be prompt-injected.
profile.motto: ship fast. break things. fix faster.

projects.title: Ferrite
projects.tagline: A browser for AI agents that can't be talked into things.
projects.description: A Rust browser built on the Servo engine. Instead of trying to spot malicious text, Ferrite predicts what a task legitimately needs, dry-runs the agent's plan in a sandbox on fake data, compares the two, and asks the user before anything off-plan runs. Every security-relevant event lands in a SHA-256 hash-chained audit log.
highlights: Sandboxed dry-runs with no real network access

projects.title: Sentinel
projects.tagline: A system monitor & firewall that explains itself.
projects.description: Cross-platform system monitor and firewall that explains every process and network connection in plain English. Native Rust core with a Tauri + React interface, running on macOS, Linux and Windows.
highlights: Per-process network visibility with plain-English explanations
Native Rust core, Tauri + React shell

projects.title: DuckOps
projects.tagline: Pick a stack. Get a repo, a k8s deploy, CI/CD and monitoring.
projects.description: A self-hosted Internal Developer Platform. Choose a language, framework, database and ORM in a wizard and DuckOps scaffolds the code, creates the GitHub repo, builds and pushes the image, provisions a Kubernetes namespace with Terraform, deploys with Ansible, wires a Jenkins pipeline and health-checks the app, streaming every stage live over Socket.io.
highlights: Live stage streaming over Socket.io, BullMQ job queue

projects.title: DevHub
projects.tagline: Postman + DevTools + Burp Suite in one workspace.
projects.description: A unified developer workspace: HTTP/WebSocket/GraphQL client, live network inspector, MITM interceptor with repeater and intruder, decoder, sequencer, a route scanner that reads your repo's AST, and a workspace-aware AI assistant. Ships as a web app and an Electron desktop app.
highlights: Intercept, edit and replay in-flight requests
AST-based API route discovery from GitHub/GitLab

projects.title: NeuroCred
projects.tagline: A live digital twin and credit engine for small businesses.
projects.description: Models a small business as a live digital twin and scores credit risk in real time: Monte Carlo risk simulation, LLM reasoning over the results and streaming anomaly detection on Redis Streams.
highlights: Real-time anomaly detection on Redis Streams

projects.title: Nebula
projects.tagline: Dynamic malware analysis with transformer networks.
projects.description: A full-stack platform that detects and explains malicious Windows software. Executables run under emulation, their API-call traces are tokenized and fed to a chunked transformer, explainable-AI attributions show what the model saw, and an LLM layer writes the threat-intel summary.
highlights: Chunked transformer over Windows API-call traces

projects.title: Vendex
projects.tagline: Reel to real: product video → ranked supplier list.
projects.description: Paste an Instagram or TikTok reel (or an Alibaba link). Vendex downloads the video, picks the sharpest frame, runs a visual search on Alibaba and returns a ranked supplier shortlist with prices, MOQs, trust badges and one-click chat. Includes a Chrome extension.
highlights: Visual supplier search with stealth Playwright

projects.title: DAP
projects.tagline: Digital asset protection against sports piracy.
projects.description: A rights-management prototype for sports media: perceptual fingerprints and invisible CNN watermarks on ingest, scraping and Hamming-distance matching to find infringing copies, an enforcement priority score, and Gemini-drafted, jurisdiction-aware takedown notices.
highlights: pHash + dHash fingerprints, HiDDeN CNN watermarking
Auto-drafted DMCA / EU DSM / IT Act notices

projects.title: CtrlFixIt
projects.tagline: Real-time competitive coding for live events.
projects.description: A competitive coding game platform built for live events, with live scoreboards over WebSockets, Docker-sandboxed code execution via Piston, single-session enforcement and server-authoritative timing. Tuned to run 150+ concurrent jobs on a single host.

projects.title: BoomSuite
projects.tagline: Break Apple's volume ceiling, up to 4× louder.
projects.description: Two native apps: BoomPlayer for iOS (local music player with a 4× gain stage, EQ presets and lock-screen controls) and BoomMac for macOS (system-wide audio booster for any app via CoreAudio).
highlights: AVAudioEngine gain stage with EQ presets

projects.title: skrgrep
projects.tagline: A fast, multi-threaded grep, in Rust.
projects.description: A line-oriented search tool with a work-stealing thread pool, fast recursive traversal that skips .git, node_modules and target, and highlighted matches. Installable via Homebrew.

projects.title: Poker
projects.tagline: Real-time multiplayer poker with a Rust backend.
projects.description: An online poker platform with a real-time Rust backend (Axum, Tokio, SQLx) and a Next.js 15 frontend, synchronising game state over WebSockets.

experience.description: Designing and shipping my own products end to end: from a Rust agent browser and a cross-platform firewall to an internal developer platform running on Kubernetes.
Regular at hackathons and engineering challenges, shipping working prototypes under time pressure.
Built the chapter's web presence and event tooling: the main site, TechWeek registrations, an admin dashboard and CtrlFixIt, a real-time coding arena for live events.
